name: incident.io
description: Manage your full incident.io workspace from one place. Declare and triage incidents, ack pages, check who's on call, and track follow-ups - without switching tools. Analyze incident trends, escalation response rates, and alert noise across your organization. Browse your catalog, query telemetry from connected observability tools, and run structured operational reviews. Everything your team needs to stay on top of things, without the tab juggling.

_published_faq.name: How do I add incident.io to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add incident.io to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.incident.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the incident.io MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: incident.io lists 35 MCP tools, including alert_list, alert_show, alert_source_list, alert_stats, analysis_start, ask, ask_incident, ask_telemetry, catalog_entry_list, catalog_entry_show, catalog_type_list, and escalation_list.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to incident.io?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to incident.io in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
incident.io requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
incident.io is developed by incident.io. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
